errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis values are spaced by one unit ('през една единица'). The axis shows odd numbers from 1 to 23, meaning the interval between them is two units.

errors.text_span: в диаграмата „Text“ стълбът при индекс 17 е съставен изцяло от сегмента „Expert 4“ (100%)
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. In the 'Text' chart, the bar at index 17 is composed of 'Expert 2' (orange, approximately 82%) and 'Expert 4' (red, approximately 18%), not 100% 'Expert 4'.

errors.text_span: bei Index 9 füllt das grüne Segment nahezu 100 % des Balkens aus
errors.evidence: In the left chart ("Text") at index 9, the green segment (Expert 3) occupies about 80% of the bar, not nearly 100%. The remaining ~20% is occupied by the orange segment (Expert 2).

errors.text_span: sowie bei den Indizes 19 und 23 mit jeweils etwa 85 %
errors.evidence: In the right chart ("Image"), the blue segment for index 19 is about 80%, while for index 23 it is about 85%. The description incorrectly states that the value for each ("jeweils") is approximately 85%.
